snippet.title: Pirates VR: Jolly Roger - Announcement Trailer I PS VR2 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013464

Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Pirates VR Jolly Roger, a VR action-adventure pirate game developed by Split Light Studio and published by VrKiwi. Players will live out the legendary tales of iconic pirates from history from the humble beginnings of being on a deserted island to attaining treasure like no other. Avoid obstacles and traps to find the secrets and mystery of lost treasure. Pirates VR Jolly Roger is launching on 15th of May on PS VR2.

#ps5 #psvr2 #psvr2games
